description: This file defines the MembershipService class, which provides various methods for managing memberships, including CRUD operations and data normalization within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: MembershipService
classes.description: Service class for handling business logic related to memberships, including CRUD operations and data normalization.

methods.name: getMembershipDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the MembershipDao instance used for database interactions.

methods.name: setMembershipDao
methods.description: Sets the MembershipDao instance, allowing dependency injection.

methods.name: saveMembership
methods.description: Saves a membership entity to the database via the DAO.

methods.name: getMembershipById
methods.description: Retrieves a membership by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getMembershipByName
methods.description: Retrieves a membership by its name.

methods.name: getMembershipList
methods.description: Fetches a list of memberships based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getMembershipCount
methods.description: Counts the number of memberships matching search criteria.

methods.name: deleteMemberships
methods.description: Deletes memberships identified by an array of IDs.

methods.name: isExistingMembershipName
methods.description: Checks whether a membership name already exists.

methods.name: getMembershipArray
methods.description: Returns a normalized array of membership models for external use.
